jobs.description:
As a Global Operations specialist, you will manage the full lifecycle of leasing contracts.

 

Client Details

 
Our client is a leading international organization specializing in technology lifecycle management and financing solutions, supporting businesses across a wide range of industries. With a strong global presence and a collaborative culture, they offer innovative services that help companies optimize the use, management, and renewal of their technology assets.

 

Description

 
As a Global Operations Specialist, you will ensure the efficient administration of leasing contracts throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include;

• Processing orders and purchases
• Managing leasing schedules and invoices
• Maintaining customer and supplier data
• Coordinating deliveries and returns
• Handling documentation
• Providing operational support to customers while driving process improvements.

 

 
The ideal candidate is fluent in Dutch, French, and English and possesses strong administrative and organizational skills. You have excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, are comfortable working with complex systems, and bring experience from an international environment. You are proactive, detail-oriented, able to prioritize effectively, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively to deliver high-quality results.

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.

For Procter & Gamble BIC (Brussels Innovation Center) in Strombeek, we are looking for an enthusiast Lab assistant. 

What do we expect from you :

Technical Assistants perform procedural work in a lab and on a computer. 

Their role is to prepare test/products, perform routine assigned tests and/or generate data in a reliable, quality manner. 

In addition, they manage relevant administrative tasks.

They do not have an overall project responsibility but their work is vital for the development of foundational scientific understanding and the evaluation of new hypotheses. Technical Assistants can contribute to the digital data capturing or have to become savvy on this.

In their work, Technical Assistants: 

 
• Learn new test methods and prepare and perform them with excellence, in a dependable/quality manner. 
– Have knowledge of data retrieval/analysis processes; working knowledge of computer application/software packages. 
–Check accuracy of data; detects any irregularities and report these to the supervisor/technical coach. 
– Perform routine work in R&D labs independent in limited aspects of job. 
– Ask questions to resolve uncertainty about the task. 
– Priorities are defined by their supervisor/technical coach; limited control over schedule & method of work.
– Have written and verbal communication skills necessary to convey information and report the data to
their supervisor/technical coach. 

Your Skills we are looking for: 

 
• Can organize daily work independently: meeting deadlines and changing priorities 
 
• Can work in larger team, with different type of colleagues and levels. 
 
• Can work with general MS Office: Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook 
 
• Analytical mind set and eye for detail 
 
• Strong follow-up skills 
 
• Able to flag unexpected results 
 
• Participate in meetings to align weekly test program with supervisor
 -Eager to learn: via online-trainings or from colleagues 
 
• Language skills: Fluent in English

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again
 

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

As Sales Account Manager Export, you will be responsible for expanding and strengthening our business across international markets outside Western Europe.
 

You will focus primarily on developing relationships with large customers and distributors, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term partnerships.
 

You combine a strategic outlook with a hands-on approach to drive sales performance and unlock new opportunities.
 

Key responsibilities:
 

• Develop and manage relationships with key accounts and international distributors 

• Drive sales growth across export markets outside Western Europe 

• Identify and develop new business opportunities in assigned regions 

• Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts 

• Set-up, manage, motivate, and support a network of agents 

• Monitor sales performance and ensure targets are achieved 

• Analyze market trends and customer needs to define growth strategies 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and supply chain 

• Represent the company at international trade fairs and customer meetings 

• You will translate internal commercial strategies into action and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process via our CRM platform (Dynamics 365). 

• Proven experience in an international sales or export role 

• Strong experience managing key accounts and/or distributors 

• Commercially driven with excellent negotiation skills 

• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented 

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills 

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus) 

• Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds
• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds
• Providing general technical support
• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential
• Able to work very precisely and neatly
• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage
• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools
• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team
• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement
• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed
• Positive, constructive attitude
• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

As Receptionist & Facility Officer, you will be the first point of contact for members and visitors and will support the smooth day-to-day operation of the office.
 

You will manage reception and visitor processes, oversee office readiness, coordinate meeting rooms and on-site event logistics, and support essential services such as catering, stationery, mailroom and archives.
 

You will also coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance of key facility systems and assist with practical facility projects, including storage and furniture inventory. Through this varied role, you will help provide a professional, safe and positive working environment for employees, members and visitors. You will work at the  Secretariat in Brussels, reporting directly to the Facility Manager.
 

Your responsibilities 
 

 Your responsibilities will vary based on priorities and projects and may include, but are not limited to: 

 
• bull;    Act as the main point of contact for  members and visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming reception experience. 
 
• bull;    Carry out daily office checks and take appropriate action to ensure that workspaces are clean, functional and ready for daily operations. 
 
• bull;    Support catering coordination, stationery, the mailroom and archives to ensure the availability of essential office resources. 
 
• bull;    Manage meeting room bookings, room set-up and associated services, and coordinate logistical support for on-site events. 
 
• bull;    Coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance for electrical systems, HVAC, access control, alarms, audiovisual systems and other key equipment. 
 
• bull;    Assist with facility projects, including storage management and maintenance of the furniture inventory, to support the effective use of space and resources. 
  

We are looking for a motivated candidate with the following skills and abilities:
 
 
 
• High school qualification or an equivalent level gained through professional experience. 
 
• 1-3 years of relevant experience in reception, office services or facilities support. 
 
• Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools, including Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook and SharePoint. 
 
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, with a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
 
• A collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to build positive working relationships and respond effectively to different audiences. 
 
• A strong sense of accountability, reliability and integrity, with the ability to follow procedures and meet commitments. 
 
• Good organisational and problem-solving skills, including the ability to plan, prioritise and deliver work on time. 
 
• Ability to work independently and in a team setting while managing competing priorities. 
 
• Willingness and availability to work from the office five days a week (Monday to Friday). 
 
• Positive mindset aligned with the values of  Team, Trust, Integrity, Excellence and Future-thinking.

Your Role? 
 
 

• Process and verify purchase invoices and expense reports with a high level of accuracy. 

• Prepare supplier payments and follow up on outstanding balances. 

• Process bank statements and monitor cash reporting. 

• Support the preparation of VAT and intra-community (IC) declarations. 

• Assist in the reconciliation of balance sheet accounts. 

• Contribute to month-end and year-end closing activities. 

• Support audit preparation and ensure compliance with internal and external requirements. 

• Ensure financial data is processed accurately, timely, and consistently. 

• Support Corporate Income Tax (CIT) preparation. 

• Contribute to ad hoc projects and process improvement initiatives.  

 
 

Your Profile: 
 
 

• You have initial experience in General accounting 

• Experience with SAP is required. 

• You have a solid understanding of accounting principles. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You combine strong analytical skills with a hands-on mindset. 

• You are accurate, detail-oriented, and well organized. 

• You are proactive and willing to take initiative. 

• You think critically, challenge constructively, and propose solutions. 

• You are eager to learn and comfortable exploring new tools and systems independently. 

• You can manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• You are a team player with strong communication skills.

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.
